title: UK ETS aviation simplified-reporting QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: Simplified reporting may be used where full-scope flight emissions are below 25,000 tonnes CO2 per year.
Simplified reporting may also apply where aviation-activity emissions are below 3,000 tonnes CO2 per year.
A simplified reporter must obtain a draft emissions report from Eurocontrol ETS-SF.
ETS-SF data must be checked against the operator's own flight records before use.
Incorrect ETS-SF data should be corrected with Eurocontrol before it is used.
facts.expected_handling: Block uncorrected data from final reporting.

facts.source_fact: Requesting draft ETS-SF data in October is recommended to allow time for corrections.
facts.expected_handling: Treat as timing guidance, not statutory deadline.

facts.source_fact: A small emitter can be defined by fewer than 243 full-scope flights per period for 3 consecutive 4-month periods.
A small emitter can also be defined by total annual emissions below 25,000 tonnes CO2.
Use of the Eurocontrol Small Emitters Tool requires verification by an accredited independent verifier.
facts.expected_handling: Do not equate SET use with verifier exemption.

facts.source_fact: SET inputs should use the most accurate actual ground flight track distance for each aerodrome pair.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute a generic distance rule.

guard_patterns.handling: Do not use known-incorrect ETS-SF data.
Preserve verification requirement for SET use.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
